noun_definition: web refers to the online platform where users can interact with the application, specifically in the context of submitting expenses and managing transactions.
Search refers to the action of looking for a specific held transaction within the new search page after submitting expenses and holding a request.

Hold request education modal refers to a user interface element that provides information or guidance to the user after they have held a request, but is expected to appear when searching for a held transaction.
top left refers to the position on the screen where the hold request education modal is expected to open when triggered by the user action described in the issue.
